press.comment: I like the three firs toptions best, but I don't like the grey background it gives
press.reply: The grey was the pressed face: when a press landed, every option turned the button, row or day a flat grey (the register's pressed colour) with a black label. It is gone from all six. Slammed home, two beats and jogged home stay exactly as they were, the red plate driven in the same way, but the face now lands as solid ink with a paper label, so you still see it is held. Ink squash and overprinted keep the paper face (the keyline and the deep red say held), and your scope-12 rule keeps paper and thickens its rule (a red button deepens its red). Nothing grey is left in the press. The other questions are unchanged.
